comment.text: DAXX 457 is represented as a recurrent in-frame indel region in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Biliary tract tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: biliarytract; Lung tumors; Pancreatic tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting DAXX the 457 region have been observed in pancreatic tumors, lung tumors, and biliary tract tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: DAXX E457del is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v2 at the 457 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.

report_comment.text: The DAXX E457del alteration has been observed in pancreatic tumors and lung tumors. Its functional and clinical significance require allele- and tumor-specific assessment.
